component.name: PrintLiner
component.summary: Live status of your Bambu Lab 3D printers

description.p: PrintLiner is a dashboard for the Bambu Lab 3D printers on your Bambu account. It signs in through the Bambu Lab cloud, so the printers stay in their normal mode and Bambu Studio and Handy keep working.

ul.li: A card per printer: state, progress, time left, layer, and filament
Printer detail: temperatures, AMS trays, HMS alerts, and task history
Trends of temperatures and progress over a day or a week
The sign-in token kept in your system keychain; the password never saved
